title_o: Seeing the forest when entry is unlikely: Probability and the mental representation of events.

replications.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
replications.quote: Contrary to the original empirical findings, we present 2 close replication attempts (N 115 and N 120; the original studies had N 20 and N 34) that failed to find the effect of likelihood on construal level. Bayesian analyses provided diagnostic support for the absence of an effect.

effect.name: Unlikely future actions are segmented into fewer units
